**01 · DECISION BRIEF**

# Quyết định nghiên cứu

> **Recommended direction — CoSign4D.** Visibility-Aware Dynamic Contact-Graph Posterior for Monocular 4D Sign Reconstruction. Novel core: contact-event graph điều kiện hóa trực tiếp score/prior của trajectory diffusion toàn thân; evidence factors chỉ hướng posterior khi cue nhìn thấy và đáng tin.

| **Kết luận**             | **Bằng chứng / hệ quả**                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|--------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Trạng thái DexAvatar** | \[V\] arXiv v1 12/2025; accepted WACV 2026, pp. 5842–5852; official repo ghi Best Paper Award Finalist.                                                                                                                     |
| **SOTA claim**           | \[V/I\] Peer-reviewed direct SGNify reference mạnh nhất đã xác minh. Không gọi là absolute current SOTA: Tamaththul3D (06/2026) và DanceHMR (05/2026) là preprint, protocol/dataset không đồng nhất.                        |
| **Blocker**              | \[V\] Evaluator hiện làm “V2V wrist” trùng với TR-V2V; independent region centering xóa lỗi hand placement. Phải sửa trước khi so sánh.                                                                                     |
| **Novelty risk**         | \[V\] A2P/CVPR 2026 đã có multi-2D-prior + penetration-free diffusion; DPoser-X đã holistic diffusion; DanceHMR đã joint temporal whole-body; CoToGrasp/ECCV 2026 đã contact-topology conditioning trong robotics.          |
| **Vì sao vẫn có cửa**    | \[I\] Chưa thấy công trình kết hợp dynamic hand–hand/hand–body/hand–face contact events với visibility-conditioned whole-body trajectory posterior cho monocular sign reconstruction và đánh giá semantic/contact/dynamics. |
| **Mức tin cậy novelty**  | Medium–High, với điều kiện claim đúng ranh giới, bổ sung forward/backward citation search trước submission và chứng minh bằng ablation mechanism-level.                                                                     |

## Success criteria trước khi viết paper

- Reproduce DexAvatar trên evaluator đã sửa; báo cả protocol cũ và mới để giữ khả năng đối chiếu.

- CoSign4D phải thắng một baseline cùng initializer và cùng observation bank; không được lấy credit từ WiLoR/SMPLest-X.

- Core contact conditioning phải hơn: (a) collision loss, (b) contact loss cộng ngoài, và (c) holistic diffusion không condition graph.

- Cải thiện phải tập trung tại contact/occlusion frames, đồng thời không làm xấu wrist-aligned hand articulation.

- Báo macro-per-sign, CI/bootstrap, temporal/contact/semantic metrics và runtime; không chỉ micro-average TR-V2V.

## Claim đề xuất

“We introduce a visibility-aware dynamic contact-graph posterior that couples holistic SMPL-X trajectory generation with contact-event inference. Unlike collision-only fitting or frame-wise whole-body priors, the contact graph modulates the denoising score across time, enabling multiple anatomically and semantically plausible reconstructions under hand–hand and hand–body occlusion.”

> **Không nên claim.** ‘First contact-aware sign reconstruction’, ‘first diffusion sign reconstruction’, ‘first temporal whole-body sign model’, hoặc ‘current SOTA’ nếu chưa chạy cùng protocol với các preprint 2026.

**02 · ANCHOR PAPER AUDIT**

# DexAvatar: paper đang làm gì — và bỏ trống điều gì

DexAvatar là một pipeline fitting SMPL-X dựa trên tối ưu, không phải một mạng video end-to-end. Nó lấy ước lượng ban đầu từ SMPLer-X cho body/camera và HaMeR cho hands; dùng Sapiens/HaMeR làm 2D keypoints; sau đó tối ưu latent body/hand priors, collision, temporal và biomechanical constraints.

| **Component**       | **Verified reading**                                                                                                                          |
|---------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Representation**  | SMPL-X; body, two hands, face parameters nhưng benchmark chính loại face.                                                                     |
| **Initialization**  | SMPLer-X body/camera + HaMeR hands.                                                                                                           |
| **Observation**     | 2D joint reprojection; Sapiens body, HaMeR hands; robust loss và confidence weights.                                                          |
| **Learned priors**  | SignBPoser và SignHPoser là VAE độc lập; body từ SignAvatars/How2Sign pseudo-SMPL-X đã lọc; hand từ mocap 8 signers, 93 fingerspelling words. |
| **Optimization**    | LBFGS; prior losses + interpenetration + first-order body temporal + biomechanical limits; hard one/two-hand decision.                        |
| **Benchmark**       | SGNify: 57 German signs, 2,872 central frames; TR-V2V Upper Body (-Face), Left Hand, Right Hand.                                              |
| **Reported result** | 30.13 / 13.53 / 13.08 mm; 35.11% upper-body và 16.32%/14.11% hand improvement so với Neural Sign Actors.                                      |

## Strengths cần giữ

- Domain data curation có hiệu quả rõ hơn việc nhồi thêm regularizer: filtered body prior tốt hơn unfiltered; filtered hand data tốt hơn raw mocap.

- Biomechanical constraints được dùng cả ở data cleaning và fitting; đây là inductive bias phù hợp với sample scarcity.

- Tách body/hand initializer tận dụng specialist hand model; phù hợp vì hands nhỏ và dễ blur/occlude.

- Optimization cho phép cắm thêm differentiable image/physics factors mà không phải retrain toàn bộ estimator.

## Gaps có khả năng tạo paper mới

| **Gap**                           | **Research implication**                                                                                                                                           |
|-----------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Independent priors**            | SignBPoser và hai SignHPoser không học dependency tay–tay, wrist–forearm, hand–body hoặc contact.                                                                  |
| **Weak temporal model**           | Ltemp chỉ penalize θb − θb(previous); không phải learned trajectory prior, không mô hình hóa multimodality và không rõ hand dynamics.                              |
| **Keypoint-only evidence**        | Silhouette, part mask, relative depth/occlusion order, dense tracks và texture evidence chưa tham gia objective.                                                   |
| **Collision ≠ contact**           | Lpen chỉ tránh interpenetration. Nó không giữ đúng patch đang chạm, không mô hình onset–hold–release, và không phân biệt gần nhau do projection với tiếp xúc thật. |
| **Hard activity switch**          | Classifier one/two-hand tắt non-dominant arm; sai classifier có thể đóng băng đúng cue. Soft activity posterior hợp lý hơn.                                        |
| **Single deterministic solution** | Monocular occlusion thường có nhiều 3D explanations; MAP fitting dễ hội tụ vào pose plausible nhưng sai semantic/contact.                                          |
| **Data/linguistic scope**         | Body pseudo-labels; hand mocap nhỏ, thiên về fingerspelling; 8 signers và Western sign languages; transfer chưa được định lượng.                                   |
| **Evaluation blind spots**        | Không có placement-preserving hand metric, temporal, contact, penetration, uncertainty, semantic preservation, macro-per-sign hoặc CI.                             |
| **Non-manual signals**            | Face bị loại khỏi primary metric dù facial expression và head movement mang thông tin ngôn ngữ.                                                                    |

## Đọc đúng ablation

Body: BPf tốt hơn BPu, nhưng BPf+bio hơi xấu hơn BPf trong prior training — dấu hiệu over-regularization. Hand: HPf tốt hơn HPu; HPf+bio chỉ thay đổi rất nhỏ và mixed. Vì vậy, ‘thêm nhiều biomechanical loss’ không phải hướng novelty hoặc performance đáng tin. Kết luận thực dụng là: ưu tiên làm sạch data/manifold và dùng physical constraints có điều kiện, không ép đồng đều mọi frame.

> **Research pivot.** Từ ‘pose plausibility per frame’ sang ‘posterior trajectory có cấu trúc’: evidence khi nhìn thấy, uncertainty khi che khuất, contact graph khi tương tác, motion prior khi cue mất.

**03 · CODE AUDIT**

# Evaluator hiện chưa đo đúng lỗi placement của bàn tay

Phát hiện dưới đây là blocker cấp Critical vì nó có thể thay đổi thứ hạng model. Line numbers tham chiếu đúng file evaluate_new_fitting(3).py đính kèm.

## Critical: “common wrist center” triệt tiêu hoàn toàn

Tại lines 172–181, cả source và target bị trừ centroid riêng rồi cộng cùng một center. Khi lấy hiệu, center biến mất:

*‖(S − μS + c) − (G − μG + c)‖₂ = ‖(S − μS) − (G − μG)‖₂* (A)

Biểu thức (A) chính là transl_point_error ở lines 159–169. Do đó V2V left/right wrist (lines 397–411) trùng TR left/right hand về mặt đại số. Nó không đo wrist alignment và không giữ vị trí bàn tay tương đối với torso.

> **Hệ quả.** Một bàn tay có articulation đúng nhưng bị dịch 10–20 cm khỏi wrist/body vẫn có thể nhận hand TR-V2V rất tốt sau khi center độc lập. Contact tay–tay/tay–thân cũng gần như vô hình với metric này.

| **Severity** | **Lines**             | **Issue**                        | **Required fix**                                                                                                      |
|--------------|-----------------------|----------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Critical** | 159–181; 397–411      | Metric duplicate                 | Thay bằng root-aligned placement PVE và predicted-wrist vs GT-wrist articulation PVE.                                 |
| **High**     | 380–395               | Mỗi region tự center             | Không dùng independent centroid cho metric placement; align toàn mesh bằng pelvis một lần.                            |
| **High**     | 231–280; 342–361      | Potential frame offset           | GT segment dùng start/end ×2; predictions luôn index từ 0. Xác minh timestamp/frame-id map, không dựa vào list index. |
| **High**     | 479–482; 301–307      | --central không điều khiển logic | Flag được parse nhưng segmentation JSON luôn áp dụng. Hoặc bỏ flag, hoặc branch rõ và test cả hai.                    |
| **Medium**   | 460–461               | Unit assumption                  | ×1000 giả định OBJ ở meter; validate units bằng body height/bounding box và log conversion.                           |
| **Medium**   | 455–461               | Micro-average only               | Concat mọi vertex/frame khiến sign dài nặng hơn. Báo macro-per-sign + CI song song.                                   |
| **Medium**   | 382–383; 515–547      | Global mutable state             | class_sign/left_hand_ids là globals bên trong main; truyền explicit để test/reproduce.                                |
| **Medium**   | 473–477; 521; 575–588 | method list/type confusion       | args.method là list nhưng gán vào mapping; chuẩn hóa method_id và path mapping.                                       |
| **Medium**   | 369–370               | Brittle topology check           | Exact face order phù hợp SMPL-X nhưng cần error message + vertex-count/model-version checks.                          |
| **High**     | Toàn file             | Missing dimensions               | Không temporal/contact/penetration/occlusion/semantic/runtime/uncertainty metrics.                                    |

## Protocol metric thay thế

> 1\. Root-aligned whole-body/region PVE: trừ predicted pelvis cho prediction và GT pelvis cho GT; dùng cùng alignment cho all regions. Đây là metric hand placement chính.
>
> 2\. Wrist-aligned hand PVE: trừ predicted wrist và GT wrist tương ứng. Đây là articulation-only metric, không thay thế placement.
>
> 3\. Raw/root-relative MPJPE/MPVPE: giữ camera/world placement khi calibration đủ tin cậy.
>
> 4\. Dynamics: MPJVE, acceleration error, jerk, jitter spectral energy; report transition/contact/blur subsets.
>
> 5\. Interaction: contact precision/recall/F1, contact-patch accuracy, signed penetration depth/volume, minimum surface distance.
>
> 6\. Anatomy: joint-limit violation rate và severity; không chỉ tính V2V với GT có thể bất khả thi.
>
> 7\. Semantics: frozen sign embedding/recognizer, gloss accuracy hoặc SiLVERScore; kèm human preference trên subset.
>
> 8\. Statistics: macro-per-sign, per-signer/language, bootstrap 95% CI, paired tests, ≥3 seeds khi có training.

## Two-axis hand reporting

| **Metric**                       | **Measures**                        | **Role**                                             |
|----------------------------------|-------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| **Root-aligned hand PVE ↓**      | Wrist/hand placement + articulation | Primary geometry metric                              |
| **Wrist-aligned hand PVE ↓**     | Local finger articulation           | Diagnostic; gần protocol cũ nhưng center đúng joint  |
| **Contact F1 ↑ / penetration ↓** | Topology & physics                  | Core CoSign4D claim                                  |
| **Velocity/acceleration/jerk ↓** | Temporal coherence                  | Tránh smooth-but-wrong bằng semantic/contact metrics |
| **Semantic score ↑**             | Meaning preservation                | Không dùng làm bằng chứng duy nhất                   |

**04 · RESEARCH METHOD**

# Quy trình literature review đa miền

Mục tiêu không phải gom paper có từ khóa ‘sign language’, mà tìm các mechanism giải quyết cùng failure mode: tiny articulated parts, self-/mutual-occlusion, body–hand integration, multimodal posterior, dynamic contact, temporal drift, physics, semantics và benchmark bias.

| **Search cluster**          | **Transfer question**                                                                                         |
|-----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **A · Direct domain**       | 3D sign reconstruction; sign avatars; sign production/recognition; sign semantics; fingerspelling.            |
| **B · Expressive HMR**      | SMPL-X whole-body, body–hand fusion, robustness, close-up/crop, camera/world grounding.                       |
| **C · Video/4D**            | trajectory priors, global motion, temporal transformers, sparse/keyframe estimation, point tracking.          |
| **D · Hands & bimanual**    | single/two-hand recovery, interaction attention, occlusion, world-space hand trajectories.                    |
| **E · Generative priors**   | diffusion score guidance, masked modeling, probabilistic HMR, multi-hypothesis inference.                     |
| **F · Contact & physics**   | hand–hand/object contact, surface patches, signed distance, penetration-free denoising, force/contact events. |
| **G · Semantic evaluation** | recognition embeddings, sign-video semantic similarity, non-manual signals, human evaluation.                 |

## Inclusion / exclusion

- Ưu tiên primary source và official proceedings/project; ghi rõ peer-reviewed, accepted, preprint hoặc workshop.

- Giữ paper nếu có module chuyển giao cụ thể hoặc là closest novelty threat; không giữ chỉ vì cùng dataset/từ khóa.

- Backward snowball từ DexAvatar/SGNify/SignAvatars; forward scan đến 21.08.2026; thêm cross-domain queries theo failure mode.

- Tách evidence khỏi inference: result của paper không tự động chuyển sang sign; transferability phải được kiểm chứng qua ablation.

- Không dùng venue rank làm proxy duy nhất. Ưu tiên reproducibility, datasets, official code và direct mechanism overlap.

## Evidence ladder

| **Level**              | **Meaning**                                      | **Examples**                                     |
|------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| **E3 · Direct**        | Cùng task + dataset/protocol                     | DexAvatar, SGNify, Tamaththul3D                  |
| **E2 · Mechanistic**   | Khác task nhưng cùng failure mode/representation | A2P, DPoser-X, DanceHMR, OmniHands               |
| **E1 · Inspirational** | Mechanism xa domain, cần adaptation lớn          | CoToGrasp, ARCTIC contact, point tracking        |
| **E0 · Speculative**   | Chưa có direct evidence                          | Semantic reranking cải thiện exact mesh geometry |

> **Coverage note.** Review này rộng và có hệ thống theo mechanism, nhưng không thể chứng minh mathematical exhaustiveness của toàn bộ literature. Novelty phải được cập nhật lại sát ngày submission, đặc biệt CVPR/ECCV/ICCV 2026 và arXiv.

**05 · PRIOR-ART MAP**

# Bản đồ literature và module có thể chuyển giao

## 5.1 Direct sign reconstruction & semantics

| **Work**                                   | **Transferable module**                                         | **Use / caveat**                                                                    |
|--------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **SGNify · CVPR 2023**                     | Linguistic priors, one/two-hand logic, SGNify mocap benchmark   | Strong direct baseline; hard activity decision là risk.                             |
| **Neural Sign Actors · CVPR 2024**         | Diffusion generation of 3D sign actors                          | Chứng minh generative modeling hữu ích; task generation ≠ inverse reconstruction.   |
| **SignAvatars · ECCV 2024**                | 8.34M-frame pseudo-SMPL-X corpus, 70K videos, 153 signers       | Body trajectory pretraining/domain adapter; pseudo-label noise phải track.          |
| **DexAvatar · WACV 2026**                  | Sign-specific body/hand VAE priors + biomechanical fitting      | Anchor baseline; independent priors, weak temporal/contact modeling.                |
| **Tamaththul3D · arXiv 2026**              | WiLoR hands + closed-form swing–twist forearm/wrist integration | High-value initializer/efficiency module; preprint and protocol must be reproduced. |
| **Large Sign Language Models · WACV 2026** | 3D ASL representation/translation                               | Possible semantic encoder; not direct mesh-fitting evidence.                        |
| **SiLVERScore · RANLP 2025**               | Sign-video embedding metric for semantic/prosodic fidelity      | Evaluation/reranking candidate; dataset generalization remains a limitation.        |

## 5.2 Expressive whole-body reconstruction

| **Work**                     | **Transferable module**                                                                   | **Use / caveat**                                                                                        |
|------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **SMPLer-X · NeurIPS 2023**  | Generalist whole-body initialization and massive training scale                           | Current DexAvatar initializer; retain as reproducible baseline.                                         |
| **AiOS · CVPR 2024**         | All-in-one-stage expressive body/hand/face estimation                                     | Alternative holistic initialization; useful ablation against specialist fusion.                         |
| **Multi-HMR · ECCV 2024**    | Single-shot multi-person 3D humans incl. hands                                            | Relevant for crowd/multiple signers; not core single-signer novelty.                                    |
| **SMPLest-X · TPAMI 2026**   | Strong foundation-model whole-body estimator                                              | Potential stronger init; isolate gains from novel posterior.                                            |
| **RoboSMPLX · NeurIPS 2023** | Localization/pixel alignment/box-augmentation robustness                                  | Transfer crop/scale robustness to tiny hands and missed boxes.                                          |
| **DanceHMR · arXiv 2026**    | Joint temporal body–hand residual fusion, missing-joint embeddings, close-up augmentation | Closest threat to ‘temporal holistic fusion’; preprint, not sign-specific/contact-topology conditioned. |

## 5.3 Video HMR, motion priors & tracks

| **Work**                       | **Transferable module**                                  | **Use / caveat**                                                                   |
|--------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **HuMoR · ICCV 2021**          | Learned conditional motion prior for robust optimization | Template for prior-as-dynamics rather than frame regularizer.                      |
| **LEMO · ICCV 2021**           | Motion smoothness learned from latent features           | Temporal fitting reference; smoothness alone can erase sign transitions.           |
| **DeciWatch · ECCV 2022**      | Sparse-frame estimation + temporal recovery              | Efficiency track: uncertainty-selected keyframes.                                  |
| **WHAM · CVPR 2024**           | World-grounded motion and motion context                 | Camera/global trajectory factors; lower priority for mostly static signing camera. |
| **GVHMR · SIGGRAPH Asia 2024** | Gravity/world-grounded video HMR                         | Useful when camera moves; validate if benchmark is fixed-camera.                   |
| **WHAC · ECCV 2024**           | World-grounded human and camera motion                   | Camera disentanglement; supporting rather than core.                               |
| **DiffMesh · WACV 2025**       | Motion-aware diffusion for video mesh recovery           | Closest diffusion trajectory prior; body-centric, no detailed contact graph.       |
| **ReMP · WACV 2025**           | Reusable multi-domain motion prior                       | Domain-adaptive prior design; candidate pretraining objective.                     |
| **SpatialTracker · CVPR 2024** | 3D-aware dense point trajectories under ambiguity        | Dense hand/garment/image evidence; must gate unreliable occluded tracks.           |

## 5.4 Hand, bimanual interaction & occlusion

| **Work**                   | **Transferable module**                                       | **Use / caveat**                                                                                         |
|----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **HaMeR · CVPR 2024**      | Transformer hand reconstruction and large-scale hand data     | DexAvatar initializer/keypoints; single-frame ambiguity remains.                                         |
| **WiLoR · CVPR 2025**      | In-the-wild localization + reconstruction                     | Strong hand init and crop recovery; used by Tamaththul3D.                                                |
| **HandOS · CVPR 2025**     | One-stage hand detection/reconstruction                       | Alternative to crop cascade; efficiency/robustness ablation.                                             |
| **Hamba · NeurIPS 2024**   | Graph/state-space hand modeling                               | Part-aware token design; not direct video/contact solution.                                              |
| **MaskHand · ICCV 2025**   | Masked generative hand modeling under occlusion               | Visibility/missingness curriculum for hand tokens.                                                       |
| **ACR · CVPR 2023**        | Attention collaboration for arbitrary two-hand reconstruction | Inter-hand feature coupling; frame-based.                                                                |
| **InterPrior · ICCV 2023** | Explicit interaction prior for two hands                      | Closest static interaction prior; does not cover hand–body events over time.                             |
| **HHMR · CVPR 2024**       | Controllable holistic hand mesh recovery                      | Multimodal/control perspective; still hand-focused.                                                      |
| **HaWoR · CVPR 2025**      | World-space hand motion from egocentric video                 | World trajectory/camera disentanglement; viewpoint differs from sign video.                              |
| **Dyn-HaMR · CVPR 2025**   | 4D interacting hand motion with dynamic camera                | Temporal two-hand motion prior; no full body/sign semantic coupling.                                     |
| **OmniHands · TOG 2026**   | Relation-aware two-hand tokens + 4D interaction reasoning     | Very close for bimanual dynamics; proposed claim must center hand–body/face graph and inverse posterior. |

## 5.5 Diffusion, uncertainty, heterogeneous cues & physics

| **Work**                      | **Transferable module**                                            | **Use / caveat**                                                                     |
|-------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **ScoreHMR · CVPR 2024**      | Score-guided diffusion as an inverse-problem prior                 | Direct template for posterior guidance with 2D evidence.                             |
| **DPoser-X · ICCV 2025 Oral** | Masked mixed-data whole-body diffusion prior                       | Best prior initialization idea; holistic alone is not novel.                         |
| **DPMesh · CVPR 2024**        | Diffusion prior for occluded HMR                                   | Evidence that generative priors help occlusion; body-centric.                        |
| **MEGA · CVPR 2025**          | Masked generative autoencoder for HMR                              | Mask curriculum/uncertainty; alternative lighter prior.                              |
| **A2P · CVPR 2026**           | Keypoint+mask+depth alignment; penetration-free two-hand diffusion | Major novelty collision: cannot claim multi-cue or penetration-free diffusion alone. |
| **ARCTIC · CVPR 2023**        | 2.1M frames of accurate bimanual hand–object contact               | Cross-domain contact pretraining; object contact ≠ hand–body sign contact.           |
| **PICO · CVPR 2025**          | Joint reconstruction of people in contact with objects             | Contact-conditioned fitting design; transfer surface-contact factors.                |
| **PhysPT · CVPR 2024**        | Physics-aware pretrained transformer for human dynamics            | Optional physical dynamics regularizer; may overconstrain rapid signing.             |
| **CoToGrasp · ECCV 2026**     | Contact-topology-conditioned grasp synthesis                       | Closest wording collision from robotics; topology itself is not the contribution.    |

## Synthesis: modules worth borrowing vs claims already occupied

| **Decision**            | **Content**                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|-------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Borrow**              | WiLoR/HandOS init; swing–twist wrist integration; multi-cue keypoint/mask/depth; masked mixed-data prior; score-guided inference; relation tokens; contact surface patches; sign embedding evaluation.                 |
| **Do not claim as new** | Whole-body diffusion; temporal body–hand fusion; bimanual relation modeling; penetration-free diffusion; heterogeneous 2D priors; contact topology by itself.                                                          |
| **Novel opportunity**   | Dynamic contact-event graph that conditions the full SMPL-X trajectory posterior under visibility/uncertainty, including hand–body/face interactions, plus a corrected contact/placement/semantic evaluation protocol. |

**06 · METHOD PORTFOLIO**

# Bảy hướng ứng viên và quyết định chọn

Scoring 0–5; weighted score = Novelty 20% + expected performance 20% + coherence 15% + feasibility 15% + evidence 10% + low implementation risk 5% + ablation clarity 5% + generalization 5% + publishability 5%. Đây là decision aid, không phải kết quả thực nghiệm.

| **ID** | **Direction**         | **Core**                                                       | **N** | **Perf** | **Coh** | **Feas** | **Score** |
|--------|-----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|-------|----------|---------|----------|-----------|
| **M5** | CoSign4D core         | Dynamic contact graph conditions holistic trajectory posterior | 4.5   | 4.6      | 4.5     | 3.1      | 4.21      |
| **M3** | Multi-cue fitting     | Keypoints + masks + depth/order + dense tracks + visibility    | 3.1   | 4.2      | 4.2     | 3.5      | 3.89      |
| **M1** | Initializer++         | SMPLest-X/SMPLer-X + WiLoR + Tamaththul3D-style IK             | 2.0   | 4.2      | 4.5     | 4.5      | 3.81      |
| **M7** | Adaptive keyframes    | Uncertainty-driven DeciWatch/track optimization for speed      | 3.2   | 3.5      | 4.0     | 4.0      | 3.81      |
| **M6** | Semantic K-hypothesis | Multiple trajectories + frozen sign-semantic reranking         | 4.0   | 3.8      | 4.0     | 2.4      | 3.62      |
| **M4** | Temporal fusion       | DanceHMR-style joint body–hand sequence model                  | 2.2   | 4.4      | 4.3     | 3.2      | 3.59      |
| **M2** | Holistic prior swap   | Thay independent VAEs bằng DPoser-X/sign adapter               | 2.3   | 4.0      | 4.0     | 3.5      | 3.54      |

## Decision

- **Main paper:** M5 CoSign4D, nhưng dùng M1 và M3 như supporting infrastructure đã được kiểm soát bằng ablation.

- **Safe fallback:** M3 + M7 thành một paper efficiency/robust fitting nếu dynamic contact prior không vượt go/no-go gate.

- **High-risk extension:** M6 chỉ thêm sau khi geometry/contact core đã thắng; semantic reranking không được che giấu lỗi mesh.

- Không khuyến nghị làm paper chỉ với M1/M2/M4: dễ đạt gain nhưng novelty đã bị prior art 2025–2026 chiếm phần lớn.

## Fusion rule để tránh ‘Frankenstein method’

Mỗi borrowed module phải có một failure mode duy nhất và interface rõ. Initializer chỉ đưa proposal; observation bank chỉ tạo evidence; contact graph là latent structural variable; trajectory diffusion là prior/posterior engine. Nếu bỏ contact conditioning mà architecture vẫn y hệt, contribution chưa đủ mạnh.

**07 · RECOMMENDED METHOD**

# CoSign4D: Visibility-Aware Dynamic Contact-Graph Posterior

Bài toán: từ monocular RGB video Y₁:T, ước lượng trajectory SMPL-X X₁:T cùng uncertainty và dynamic contact graph C₁:T. Contact graph không phải output phụ; nó là latent variable làm thay đổi conditional trajectory distribution.

![CoSign4D architecture: observation bank and strong initialization feed a dynamic contact graph and holistic trajectory state; both condition a structured posterior that outputs ranked SMPL-X trajectories with uncertainty and contact estimates.](data:image/png;base64,)

*Figure 1 · CoSign4D architecture. Borrowed estimators generate evidence/proposals; novelty resides in graph-conditioned posterior coupling.*

## 7.1 Core hypothesis

> **H1.** Khi hands bị che khuất hoặc motion blur, raw 2D keypoints không xác định duy nhất 3D pose; nhưng contact patch identity và contact phase thường ổn định hơn về topology. Conditioning trajectory prior on C₁:T sẽ giảm root-aligned hand placement/contact errors mạnh nhất tại occlusion/contact frames.
>
> **H2.** Dynamic onset–hold–release graph tốt hơn collision-only hoặc attraction loss tĩnh vì nó không kéo hai surface lại gần khi không contact và không làm mất contact thật khi 2D evidence biến mất.
>
> **H3.** Multiple posterior samples chỉ có giá trị nếu uncertainty được calibrated và top-1 reranking dựa trên evidence độc lập; min-of-K không đủ để claim deployment quality.

## 7.2 State representation

Trajectory state X₁:T gồm global orientation/translation, body pose, left/right hand pose, jaw/expression (nếu supervision đủ), shape β và camera. Dùng joint/part tokens với shared kinematic embeddings; left/right symmetry embedding nhưng không ép identical motion.

Contact graph C₁:T có nodes là semantic surface patches: palms, five fingertip groups per hand, forearms, upper arms, chest/torso, shoulders và face/head. Sparse edges chỉ xét anatomically reachable pairs. Edge feature gồm contact probability, nearest patch pair, signed distance, normal compatibility, relative velocity, visibility và phase {onset, hold, release, none}.

## 7.3 Probabilistic factorization

*p(X₁:T, C₁:T \| Y₁:T) ∝ pφ(X₁:T \| C₁:T, Mvis) · pη(C₁:T \| Y₁:T) · ∏k ψk(Yk \| X₁:T, Mvis)* (1)

pφ là sign-adapted holistic trajectory diffusion prior; pη là dynamic contact/event model; ψk là heterogeneous observation factors. Mvis chứa visibility/confidence/missingness để cue bị che không bị coi như coordinate zero.

*E = Eobs + λscore Ediff + λact Eactive-contact + λpen Epenetration + λphase Egraph-transition + λbio Ebiomech + λsem Esemantic* (2)

Eactive-contact chỉ hút/căn normals khi edge đang active; Epenetration luôn hoạt động. Tách hai term này là thiết yếu: collision-free không đồng nghĩa đúng contact, còn global attraction tạo false contacts.

## 7.4 Module design

| **Module**                  | **Concrete implementation**                                                                                                                                 |
|-----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Observation bank**        | Sapiens/body keypoints; HaMeR/WiLoR hands; part masks; monocular relative depth/occlusion order; dense tracks; all cached per video.                        |
| **Proposal initializer**    | SMPLer-X or SMPLest-X + specialist hands; geometric swing–twist wrist/forearm reconciliation; soft activity probabilities instead of hard hand switch.      |
| **Trajectory denoiser**     | Temporal transformer or diffusion transformer over holistic SMPL-X part tokens; 32–64-frame windows with overlap; relative rotations and velocity channels. |
| **Contact graph encoder**   | Edge-aware graph transformer; cross-attention from body/hand trajectory tokens to contact edge tokens at every denoising block.                             |
| **Visibility conditioning** | Masked mixed training; explicit visible/occluded/cropped/noisy states; classifier-free drop of contact/evidence conditions for robustness.                  |
| **Posterior inference**     | K latent trajectories via score guidance; alternate X-update and soft C-update; final differentiable render/energy refinement.                              |
| **Reranker**                | Image evidence + contact likelihood + anatomy + optional frozen semantic embedding; report both top-1 and oracle/min-of-K.                                  |

## 7.5 Inference algorithm

> 1\. Run/cached 2D priors; calibrate confidence and derive visibility/occlusion masks.
>
> 2\. Initialize holistic SMPL-X and reconcile wrist/forearm geometry; estimate initial soft contact graph from 2D proximity + 3D signed distance + motion.
>
> 3\. For each overlapping window, sample K trajectories from pφ with observation/contact score guidance.
>
> 4\. Update C probabilities from sampled geometry and image evidence; apply phase-transition hysteresis; repeat 2–3 alternating rounds.
>
> 5\. Refine top candidates with differentiable keypoint/mask/depth/track factors, active-contact energy and penetration barrier.
>
> 6\. Stitch windows using overlap consensus in root-relative rotations/velocities; output best path, uncertainty and contact timeline.

## 7.6 What is borrowed vs new

| **Layer**                  | **Claim**                                                                                                                                                                       |
|----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Borrowed / replaceable** | 2D detectors, body/hand initializers, swing–twist IK, generic diffusion backbone, mask/depth foundation priors, point tracker.                                                  |
| **New mechanism**          | Dynamic contact-event graph as conditioning of the holistic trajectory score; alternating graph–trajectory posterior inference; visibility-conditioned active-contact guidance. |
| **New protocol**           | Placement-preserving evaluation + contact event/penetration/dynamics/semantic/uncertainty metrics on sign-specific subsets.                                                     |

## Novelty falsification checklist

- Search exact phrases and synonyms: dynamic contact graph, contact-event conditioned diffusion, hand–body contact reconstruction, sign contact prior, topology-conditioned HMR, interacting whole-body trajectory.

- Forward citations của DexAvatar, A2P, DPoser-X, DanceHMR, OmniHands và CoToGrasp ngay trước submission.

- Nếu tìm thấy exact graph-conditioned whole-body trajectory reconstruction, pivot contribution sang sign-specific event supervision + uncertainty/calibration benchmark hoặc efficiency.

- Viết related work theo axes/mechanisms, không theo domain labels; reviewer sẽ tìm overlap ngoài sign language.

> **Key defense.** Một ‘novel combination’ chỉ thuyết phục nếu coupling tạo hành vi không thể đạt bằng cộng loss. Cross-attention/conditioning từ contact edge tokens vào denoising score và alternating C↔X inference là phần phải chứng minh.

**09 · BUILD PLAN**

# Training, data mixture và implementation roadmap

## 9.1 Data curriculum

| **Tier**                    | **Sources**                                                                          | **Role / leakage rule**                                                                  |
|-----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Generic holistic motion** | AMASS / SMPL-X-compatible motion                                                     | Pretrain kinematics, temporal dynamics; no sign claim.                                   |
| **Expressive/sign body**    | SignAvatars + How2Sign-derived trajectories                                          | Sign-space adapter; retain pseudo-label confidence and source IDs.                       |
| **Hands/interactions**      | ARCTIC, InterHand2.6M/Re:InterHand where licensing permits                           | Hand articulation, mutual occlusion, contact geometry; retarget MANO→SMPL-X carefully.   |
| **Direct benchmark**        | SGNify 57 signs                                                                      | Test only for headline comparison; create validation without leaking test signs/signers. |
| **Contact annotations**     | Auto-label signed-distance + normal compatibility; manually verify stratified subset | Avoid learning detector artifacts as contact truth.                                      |
| **Semantic**                | Frozen sign encoder/SiLVERScore-compatible data                                      | Evaluation/reranking only first; do not contaminate geometry baseline.                   |

## 9.2 Masked mixed training

Mỗi batch có part-availability mask: body-only, hand-only, full-body, contact-labeled, sign-labeled. Loss chỉ áp dụng nơi có supervision; condition dropout tạo robustness. Balance batches theo dataset/task thay vì frame count để SignAvatars không nuốt hết accurate hand/contact data.

- Stage A: warm-start holistic trajectory denoiser on generic motion; body and hand part tokens.

- Stage B: sign-domain LoRA/adapter on sign trajectories; freeze phần lớn backbone để tránh catastrophic forgetting.

- Stage C: train contact graph/event head on exact + auto labels; calibrate with manually checked subset.

- Stage D: joint fine-tune graph-conditioned score with visibility/motion-blur/crop augmentation.

- Stage E: learn/rule-based posterior guidance weights on validation; SGNify test untouched.

## 9.3 Minimal viable implementation

| **Version**                        | **Deliverable**                                                      | **Decision gate**                           |
|------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------|
| **V0 · Evaluator**                 | Correct alignment, frame mapping, macro/CI, temporal/contact metrics | Must pass unit tests before model work      |
| **V1 · Baseline**                  | Reproduce DexAvatar and strong initializer under same protocol       | Establish compute/data parity               |
| **V2 · Observation bank**          | Keypoint + mask + depth/order + visibility; no diffusion             | Quantify pure evidence gains                |
| **V3 · Holistic trajectory prior** | DPoser-X/DiffMesh-inspired masked sequence prior                     | Baseline prior without contact conditioning |
| **V4 · Static contact**            | Active-contact + penetration losses                                  | Naïve sum baseline                          |
| **V5 · CoSign4D**                  | Dynamic edge tokens condition denoiser; alternating C↔X              | Core contribution                           |
| **V6 · K posterior**               | K=4/8 hypotheses + calibrated reranking                              | Optional high-risk extension                |

## 9.4 Engineering choices

- Window 48 frames, overlap 16 là starting point—not fixed claim. Run sweep 32/48/64 with latency/memory.

- Use 6D rotations internally; convert to SMPL-X axis-angle only at model boundary; preserve left/right conventions.

- Contact patches coarse-to-fine: palm/fingertips first, then finger segments/face/body. Sparse reachable-edge mask keeps graph tractable.

- Cache masks/depth/tracks; latent diffusion + DDIM/DPM solver for inference. Report detector time and optimization time separately.

- Every experiment logs code commit, model versions, detector checkpoints, SMPL-X version, units, frame IDs and seed.

## 9.5 16-week research schedule

| **Time**   | **Work**                                               | **Gate**                                   |
|------------|--------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| **W1–2**   | Evaluator repair + unit tests + DexAvatar reproduction | Protocol lock                              |
| **W3–4**   | Strong initializer + multi-cue observation bank        | M1/M3 evidence baseline                    |
| **W5–7**   | Holistic trajectory diffusion + sign adapter           | V3 beats frame VAE on temporal + placement |
| **W8–10**  | Contact graph labels/head + static contact baselines   | Contact labels calibrated                  |
| **W11–12** | Graph-conditioned denoising + alternating inference    | Core ablation wins                         |
| **W13**    | K-hypothesis/semantic optional                         | Only if core stable                        |
| **W14–15** | Full evaluation, CIs, cross-domain, human subset       | Claims frozen                              |
| **W16**    | Paper, figures, reproducibility package                | Internal reviewer pass                     |

# Evaluation protocol đủ để thuyết phục conference reviewer

## 10.1 Datasets and splits

| **Dataset**                    | **Purpose**                                                  | **Rule**                                                                       |
|--------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **SGNify**                     | Headline direct comparison; 57 German signs / central frames | Report old TR metric for continuity + corrected protocol; no training leakage. |
| **SignAvatars held-out**       | Scale and signer diversity                                   | Split by signer/video/source; acknowledge pseudo-GT.                           |
| **How2Sign in-the-wild**       | 2D/qualitative robustness and semantics                      | No fake 3D GT claims; use reprojection, temporal, human/semantic evaluation.   |
| **ARCTIC / interacting hands** | Accurate hand/contact and occlusion diagnostics              | Cross-domain only; show mechanism generalizes beyond sign.                     |

## 10.2 Metric suite

| **Axis**         | **Report**                                                                                                         |
|------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Geometry**     | Pelvis/root-aligned PVE full/upper/hand; wrist-aligned hand PVE; MPJPE; PA metric diagnostic only.                 |
| **Dynamics**     | MPJVE, acceleration error, jerk, jitter frequency energy, transition boundary error.                               |
| **Interaction**  | Contact precision/recall/F1, patch-ID accuracy, onset/offset F1/tolerance, min distance, penetration depth/volume. |
| **Plausibility** | Joint-limit violation rate/severity; bone/shape consistency; hand handedness failures.                             |
| **Robustness**   | Visible vs occluded, blur quartiles, hand pixel size, crop/truncation, one/two-hand, contact/non-contact.          |
| **Semantics**    | Frozen recognition/gloss accuracy, sign embedding/SiLVERScore, human pairwise intelligibility/naturalness subset.  |
| **Uncertainty**  | NLL/energy proxy, calibration/error–confidence curve, AUSE, top-1 vs min-of-K and diversity.                       |
| **Efficiency**   | End-to-end sec/frame, detector vs posterior time, peak VRAM, number of denoising/refinement steps.                 |
| **Statistics**   | Macro-per-sign primary, micro secondary, 95% bootstrap CI, paired test, seeds and effect sizes.                    |

## 10.3 Factorial ablation

| **ID**    | **Variant**                                 | **Question answered**        |
|-----------|---------------------------------------------|------------------------------|
| **A0**    | DexAvatar reproduced                        | Reference                    |
| **A1**    | \+ stronger initializer only                | Borrowed module gain         |
| **A2**    | \+ heterogeneous cues / visibility only     | Observation gain             |
| **B0**    | Holistic trajectory diffusion, no contact   | Prior baseline               |
| **B1**    | B0 + penetration only                       | A2P-like physical correction |

## 10.4 Falsification tests

- Shuffle contact graphs across clips. Nếu performance gần như không đổi, model bỏ qua graph hoặc gain đến từ capacity.

- Provide oracle contact graph vs predicted graph. Gap tách lỗi contact detection khỏi trajectory modeling.

- Contact/non-contact and visible/occluded 2×2 strata. Core gain phải tập trung đúng contact+occluded quadrant.

- Parameter/compute-matched denoiser without graph tokens. Chứng minh gain không chỉ do model lớn hơn.

- Static attraction vs active-contact phase. Kiểm tra false-contact rate và over-smoothing.

- GT plausibility audit. Với frames GT vi phạm anatomy, báo cả V2V và plausibility; không cherry-pick bỏ khó.

- Recognizer-independent human subset. Semantic score có thể bias theo encoder; cần signer/Deaf expert evaluation nếu có thể.

## 10.5 Go / no-go thresholds

| **Gate**          | **Pass criterion**                                                                                      |
|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Protocol**      | Unit tests prove wrist metric differs from TR; timestamp mapping exact; macro/CI stable.                |
| **Core geometry** | ≥5% relative gain on corrected root-aligned hand/upper-body macro PVE vs same-init B0, CI excludes 0.   |
| **Interaction**   | Meaningful contact-event F1/penetration improvement; no rise in false contacts.                         |
| **Articulation**  | ≤1% degradation on wrist-aligned hand PVE; otherwise graph is trading local hand quality for placement. |
| **Temporal**      | Lower acceleration/jerk without semantic/contact degradation.                                           |
| **Mechanism**     | C1/C2 beats B2 naive contact loss and matched-capacity no-graph baseline.                               |
| **Efficiency**    | Runtime documented; if impractical, publish accuracy–latency curve and activate M7 fallback.            |

> **Important.** Các ngưỡng trên là project decisions, không phải dự đoán kết quả. Nếu core không qua gate, pivot sớm sang M3+M7 thay vì thêm modules để cứu một claim yếu.

**11 · RISK CONTROL**

# Risk register và phản biện reviewer

| **Risk**   | **Failure**          | **Why**                                            | **Mitigation**                                                                                                  |
|------------|----------------------|----------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **High**   | Contact labels noisy | Distance threshold confuses near-contact/occlusion | Normals + relative velocity + temporal hysteresis; manual audit; soft labels; oracle/predicted gap.             |
| **High**   | Too many components  | Reviewer calls engineering fusion                  | Freeze supporting modules; mechanism-level ablation; one core graph-conditioning contribution.                  |
| **High**   | Novelty collision    | New 2026 work appears                              | Forward scan; narrow claim to dynamic H–H/H–B/H–F inverse posterior; pivot protocol/uncertainty if needed.      |
| **High**   | Metric/GT bias       | SGNify GT implausible; old TR hides placement      | Dual protocol, corrected metrics, plausibility/contact labels, human/semantic subset.                           |
| **Medium** | Semantic loss cheats | Recognizer artifacts drive pose                    | Keep semantic frozen and optional; geometry/contact primary; human validation.                                  |
| **Medium** | Over-smoothing       | Learned prior erases fast transitions              | Velocity/jerk + transition timing + gloss/semantic; condition on phase; preserve high-frequency finger motion.  |
| **Medium** | Domain mismatch      | ARCTIC object contact differs from sign            | Use it for local geometry pretraining only; sign adapter and direct contact subset.                             |
| **Medium** | Inference cost       | K diffusion + optimization too slow                | Latent diffusion, cached cues, fewer steps, adaptive keyframes, accuracy–latency Pareto.                        |
| **Medium** | Face scope explosion | Non-manual semantics lacks 3D GT                   | Primary body/hands; face contact/expression optional and transparently evaluated via 2D/semantic/human metrics. |

## Likely reviewer questions — concise answers

| **Question**                                            | **Defense**                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|---------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **“Is this just DexAvatar + DPoser-X + contact loss?”** | No. Baseline B2 is exactly that. CoSign4D injects edge tokens into every denoising block and alternates C↔X; C1/C2 must beat B2 under matched compute.                                                                           |
| **“A2P already uses penetration-free diffusion.”**      | Correct and cited. A2P corrects two-hand spatial plausibility from image cues; CoSign4D targets full SMPL-X video posterior and positive contact identity/phase, not only penetration.                                           |
| **“DanceHMR already fuses body and hands temporally.”** | Correct. Temporal fusion is infrastructure, not claim. The delta is dynamic hand–body/face contact events conditioning inverse posterior under visibility.                                                                       |
| **“Why sign-specific?”**                                | Contact locations/phases and fine finger/body timing are linguistically structured; evaluate larger gains on contact/occluded sign frames plus semantic preservation. Also show ARCTIC transfer to avoid a niche-only mechanism. |
| **“Can GT be trusted?”**                                | Not fully. Report legacy and corrected geometry, anatomy/contact metrics, confidence intervals and human/semantic subsets; publish evaluation audit and indices.                                                                 |
| **“Why multiple hypotheses?”**                          | Monocular occlusion is multimodal. Report top-1/calibration and oracle separately; do not use min-of-K as sole headline.                                                                                                         |

**12 · PAPER PACKAGE**

# Conference-ready story

## Provisional title

> **CoSign4D:** Visibility-Aware Dynamic Contact-Graph Posteriors for Monocular 4D Sign Reconstruction

## Three contributions

> 1\. A dynamic contact-event graph that represents hand–hand, hand–body and hand–face surface interactions and conditions a holistic SMPL-X trajectory diffusion prior over time.
>
> 2\. A visibility-aware structured posterior that fuses heterogeneous 2D evidence with contact/biomechanical factors and supports calibrated multiple hypotheses under occlusion.
>
> 3\. A corrected, interaction-sensitive evaluation protocol separating hand placement from articulation and adding dynamics, contact, penetration, uncertainty and semantic preservation.

## Draft abstract

Monocular 3D sign reconstruction remains brittle when fast articulated hands occlude one another or contact the body. Existing sign-specific fitting methods regularize body and hands with independent pose priors and collision penalties, while recent whole-body video and interacting-hand models do not explicitly preserve sign-specific contact events under missing evidence. We introduce CoSign4D, a visibility-aware structured posterior for holistic SMPL-X trajectories. CoSign4D represents hand–hand, hand–body and hand–face interactions as a dynamic surface-contact graph with onset, hold and release states. The graph conditions a trajectory diffusion score rather than acting as an additive post-hoc loss, coupling contact identity with body–hand motion across occlusions. Heterogeneous keypoint, mask, depth-order and track evidence guides multiple posterior trajectories only where observations are reliable, followed by interaction-aware refinement and calibrated reranking. We further identify a placement-blind degeneracy in a commonly used evaluation implementation and propose a protocol that separates root-aligned hand placement from wrist-aligned articulation while measuring dynamics, contact, penetration and semantic preservation. Experiments should compare the same initializer and evidence across sign-specific and cross-domain interaction datasets, with mechanism-level ablations against collision-only, static-contact and non-conditioned diffusion baselines.

> **Placeholder rule.** Abstract intentionally contains no invented numbers. Insert results only after frozen protocol, paired CIs and full ablations.

## Venue strategy

| **Venue**                   | **Needed bar**                                                                                                         | **Role**                                              |
|-----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| **CVPR / ICCV / ECCV main** | Core mechanism generalizes beyond sign; strong SGNify + ARCTIC/whole-body interaction evidence; code/protocol released | Primary target                                        |
| **3DV**                     | Strong 3D reconstruction/evaluation contribution but narrower semantic component                                       | Good fit / fallback                                   |
| **WACV**                    | Robust applied system with broad ablations and in-the-wild results                                                     | Fallback if mechanism novelty weaker                  |
| **Workshop**                | Only preliminary/no corrected benchmark/no cross-domain                                                                | Do not spend main novelty claim here unless strategic |

## Final recommendation

Bắt đầu bằng evaluator V0 và V1 reproduction. Sau đó xây M3 observation bank và V3 holistic trajectory prior như neutral baselines. Chỉ khi V5 dynamic contact conditioning thắng B2 static contact under matched compute mới khóa title/claim CoSign4D. Đây là con đường vừa tối đa hóa cơ hội performance, vừa tránh một paper ‘ghép module’ thiếu cơ chế mới.

## Source-status caveat

Tamaththul3D và DanceHMR được dùng như emerging baselines/novelty threats nhưng là preprints tại cutoff. CoToGrasp đã có tên trong official ECCV 2026 accepted list và arXiv record ngày 20.08.2026; vì vậy contact-topology conditioning không còn là một phrase novelty an toàn. Mọi claim SOTA phải dùng code/checkpoint và cùng protocol khi chúng sẵn có.

**APPENDIX B · REPRODUCIBILITY**

# Evaluator repair checklist

- [ ] Unit test: point_error_common_center(old) == transl_point_error trên random arrays; test phải chứng minh bug cũ.

- [ ] New wrist metric: source hand − predicted wrist; GT hand − GT wrist. Không cộng chung một center.

- [ ] New placement metric: align full prediction/GT by their respective pelvis once; slice hand vertices sau alignment.

- [ ] Frame identity: parse integer IDs from both GT/pred; join explicit; assert no duplicate/missing IDs; log dropped frames.

- [ ] Central switch: true/false controls segmentation; segmentation scale/fps conversion documented and tested.

- [ ] Unit validation: median body height/mesh bbox sanity check before mm conversion.

- [ ] Aggregation: save per-frame/per-sign errors; macro mean + bootstrap CI; preserve micro mean only for legacy comparison.

- [ ] Topology/model version: vertex/face count, face checksum, SMPL-X gender/version and coordinate convention logged.

- [ ] Temporal metrics computed on contiguous frame IDs only; do not bridge gaps.

- [ ] Release config, sign list, contact subset indices and exact detector checkpoints.

## Minimum experiment table for the paper

| **Block**            | **Columns**                                | **Why**                        |
|----------------------|--------------------------------------------|--------------------------------|
| **Legacy**           | TR-V2V UBody(-F)/L/R                       | Continuity with DexAvatar only |
| **Correct geometry** | Root-PVE UBody/L/R + wrist-PVE L/R         | Headline                       |
| **Interaction**      | Contact F1, onset/offset, penetration      | Core claim                     |
| **Dynamics**         | MPJVE, accel, jerk                         | Trajectory claim               |
| **Robustness**       | Occlusion/contact/blur/size strata         | Mechanism localization         |
| **Semantics**        | Frozen embedding/recognizer + human subset | Sign relevance                 |
| **Uncertainty**      | Top-1, min-of-K, calibration/AUSE          | Posterior claim                |
| **Cost**             | sec/frame, VRAM, parameters, denoise steps | Practicality                   |

> **Bottom line.** Nếu chỉ một việc được làm ngay: sửa evaluator và chạy lại DexAvatar/strong baseline. Nếu chỉ một research idea được đầu tư: dynamic contact-event conditioning của holistic trajectory posterior. Hai việc này cùng nhau tạo story vừa đáng tin vừa có novelty.
